name: Vine Whip
description: Crack a single vine of green qi from the wrist across the opponent's guard arm.

name: Tendril Net
description: Spread a web of fine tendrils across the opponent's reach so the arms tangle on the way in.

name: Twine Block
description: Twist two vines across the line of attack and let the blow slide along the twist.

name: Vine Hop
description: Fix a vine to a high point and swing across the gap in a single long hop.

name: Greenweave
description: Weave fine green threads of qi through an ally's torn skin until the edges draw together.

name: Twining Snare
description: Throw a pair of vines that wind about both of the opponent's legs and anchor into the ground.

name: Vine Volley
description: Loose a quick volley of hard vine tips that pepper the opponent from head to knee.

name: Bough Swing
description: Swing an arm of thick qi like a heavy bough across the opponent's side.

name: Bark Mantle
description: Draw a heavy cloak of layered bark qi over the shoulders and keep it up through a short fight.

name: Bough Sweep
description: Sweep a low limb of qi across the shins to spoil the opponent's advance.

name: Bough Parry
description: Lift a springy limb of qi under the incoming strike and throw it up and away.

name: Hardbark Cover
description: Grow a thick plate of hardened bark over the whole front of the body to take a heavy blow.

name: Bough Crash
description: Bring a massive limb of qi down from overhead onto the opponent's guard with the full weight of the body.

name: Sapwood Mend
description: Guide warm sap qi into an ally's deep bruise until the swelling goes down and the colour returns.

name: Pulse Sap
description: Press two fingers to an ally's wrist and set the sap qi beating in time with a steady heart.

name: Green Poultice
description: Pack a pad of qi-soaked leaves on a deep cut so it clots and draws shut.

name: Cooling Leaf
description: Lay a cool wide leaf of qi over a burn to lift the heat and stop the blistering.

name: Sap Read
description: Rest the palm on a patient's chest and follow the flow of qi through the body to find the wound.

name: Rindbalm
description: Smooth a layer of soothing bark-oil qi over strained muscle and torn tendon to ease the pain.

name: Sap Purge
description: Draw tainted blood toward the wound and flush the venom out through the bite with a stream of clean sap.

name: Sapflood
description: Flood a badly hurt ally with rushing sap qi that closes several wounds at once.

name: Rooted Fist
description: Plant both feet with roots of qi and punch with the whole weight of the ground behind it.

name: Stance Anchor
description: Lock the legs into the ground with deep roots so no throw or shove can lift the user.

name: Root Sweep
description: Pivot on the planted foot and hook a root of qi behind the opponent's leg to drop them.

name: Deep Root
description: Sink the weight into the roots and let a heavy strike push through the body into the earth.

name: Rootpull
description: Haul on a root wrapped round the opponent's ankle to drag them off their feet.

name: Root Clamp
description: Fasten several roots about the opponent's legs and arms and lock them in place for a few breaths.

name: Anchor Drive
description: Surge forward off the planted back leg and drive the shoulder into the opponent's chest.

name: Thorn Comb
description: Rake clawed fingers tipped with qi thorns down the opponent's arm or face.

name: Spike Flick
description: Flick a single hard spike of qi from the fingertips at the opponent's eye or hand.

name: Spike Guard
description: Bristle the forearm with long spikes of qi that punish any blow or grab that lands on it.

name: Thorn Skip
description: Kick off from the ground with a short burst of qi and skip two paces back out of reach.

name: Thorn Burst
description: Thrust the body outward and loose a burst of long thorns in every direction at once.

name: Barbed Chain
description: Cast a chain of barbed links round the opponent and draw it taut so each struggle cuts deeper.

name: Seed Crack
description: Press a seed charged with qi against the opponent's body and let it burst on contact.

name: Seed Volley
description: Throw a handful of hard seeds in a fast spread at the opponent's chest and face.

name: Seedshell
description: Curl inside a tough shell of qi like the husk of a seed and ride out a blow.

name: Husk Cover
description: Hold a rough husk of qi in front of the body to rake aside a thrust.

name: Sprout Leap
description: Crouch and spring upward and forward like a shoot breaking the ground.

name: Seedling Boost
description: Feed bright new-growth qi to an ally so tired limbs and a slow breath recover their spring.

name: Seed Storm
description: Fling a dense cloud of seeds that burst across a wide front and batter everyone in it.

name: Rooting Seed
description: Spit a seed at the opponent's feet that roots at once and sends up shoots to hold the legs.

name: Bamboo Whip
description: Snap a long bending cane of qi across the opponent's flank so it rebounds for a second blow.

name: Bend Guard
description: Bow the body under a strike like a cane in wind and let the force pass overhead.

name: Reed Jab
description: Thrust a stiff reed of qi forward from the fist to punch into a gap in the guard.

name: Bamboo Spring
description: Bend low and snap upright to launch the body backward or aside in one springing step.

name: Jointed Block
description: Brace the forearm with a ringed stalk of qi whose joints spread the force of a blow.

name: Cane Crack
description: Bend a thick cane of qi back to the limit and whip it forward with a loud crack.

name: Rebound Cane
description: Take a blow on a bent cane of qi and fling its force back along the same line.

name: Willow Lash
description: Flick a long supple strand of qi from the hand so it wraps and stings across the opponent's back.

name: Weeping Veil
description: Let long drooping strands of qi fall about the body to catch and slow incoming strikes.

name: Willow Sway
description: Give way to a blow with a loose waist and shoulder so it finds nothing to break.

name: Reed Listen
description: Hold a hollow reed of qi to the ground or air and hear footsteps and breaths around the user.

name: Willowbark
description: Steep an ally in the bitter pain-easing qi of willow bark to lower fever and dull a wound's ache.

name: Willow Curtain
description: Sweep a thick fall of swaying strands before the opponent's eyes until they lose track of the user.

name: Willow Draught
description: Pour cooling reed and willow qi into an ally to drive out a fever or a lingering poison.
